prompt: Create an original 90 second chamber classical instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 90 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A classical-style string ensemble piece with a flowing, elegant melody, featuring both arco and pizzicato sections, creating a sophisticated and graceful atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首古典风格的弦乐合奏曲，旋律流畅优雅，包含弓奏和拨奏部分，营造出精致而优美的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
